 Order

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This petition under section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (herein after referred to as the Code) has been preferred for quashment of criminal proceedings pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Indore in Miscellaneous Judicial Criminal Case bearing registration number MJCR No.243 of 2024 arising out of First Information Report (FIR) vide Crime No.855 of 2022 dated 03.08.2022 registered at Police Station Bhanwarkuwa, Indore District Indore (MP) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376-D, 323, 294 and 506 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

entities.text: Police Station Bhanwarkuwa, Indore District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On due consideration of the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, this petition is disposed off with a direction to the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM), Indore to dispose off Closure NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:34980 2 MCRC-41463-2024 (Khariji) Report No.02 of 2023 dated 11.03.2023 filed by the concerned Station House Officer in Crime No.855 of 2022 registered at Police Station Bhawarkuwa, District Indore (MP).
Learned CJM will make every effort to dispose of that closure matter (report) as early as possible, preferably within a period of two months from the date of order of this Court.
If the prosecutrix is not appearing even after service, then the learned CJM will proceed, in accordance with law.
(BINOD KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE rcp Kaushal Bairagi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125338775/
